sponsored.t: Relates to dispositional alternatives for children placed with local social services agencies as destitute minors
sponsored.sum: Allows the court to enter an order regarding a destitute minor freeing the child for adoption and granting guardianship and custody to the commissioner of social services for the purposes of consenting to an adoption; authorizes agencies, commissioners of public welfare and city public welfare officers to consent to such adoptions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a full year youth and young adult employment immersion program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a full year youth employment immersion pilot program for eligible youths and young adults between the ages of 16 and 24; directs the office of temporary and disability assistance to establish a youth or young adult employment immersion pilot program in 3 local social services districts, with one being located in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Creates a true cost of economic security study
sponsored.sum: Creates a true cost of economic security study to measure how much income and other resources are needed for a family of a given composition in a given geographic location to adequately meet a comprehensive set of regular household costs, set aside savings both for future planning and for short-term emergencies, and manage debt.

sponsored.t: Requires motor vehicle repair shops to disclose certain information to customers
sponsored.sum: Requires motor vehicle repair shops to disclose whether parts supplied are under warranty and the estimate for all parts and labor; provides that no work can be done without the consent of the customer; provides for fines for violations of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Creates a publicly available list of persons who have been convicted of illegal dumping
sponsored.sum: Creates a publicly available list of persons who have been convicted of illegal dumping for a period of three years.

sponsored.t: Establishes a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a study on fiscal cliffs in the state's public assistance programs and to make recommendations related thereto
sponsored.sum: Establishes a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a study on fiscal cliffs in the state's public assistance programs and to make recommendations related thereto.
sponsored.fis: No fiscal implications for state or local government.

sponsored.t: Provides for the licensing of vision impairment specialists
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensing of vision impairment specialists.

sponsored.t: Establishes the underrepresented teachers of tomorrow teacher recruitment and retention program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the underrepresented teachers of tomorrow teacher recruitment and retention program to attract and retain underrepresented certified teachers in schools which have an underrepresentation of underrepresented certified teachers; provides for grants and procedures for applying for such grants and eligibility requirements for fund distribution.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a sex trafficking awareness and prevention program
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of DMV to establish a sex trafficking awareness and prevention program to provide education and awareness literature and educational materials to trade schools, community colleges, agencies, public or private schools or persons offering instruction in the operation of commercial motor vehicles with a commercial motor vehicle license and requires applicants for commercial driver's licenses submit a certificate for completion of such program.

sponsored.t: Limits physician charges for missed appointments by patients
sponsored.sum: Relates to physician charges for missed appointments by patients; bars physicians from charging fees if a patient arrives on time for appointment but was not seen; requires written policy about missed appointments be prominently posted in patient waiting room and included in bills mailed to patients.

sponsored.t: Enacts the menopause awareness improvement act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the menopause awareness improvement act; establishes a menopause education program; establishes course work or training in menopausal health; directs the commissioner of labor to conduct a study on the impact of menopause on the workforce.

sponsored.t: Changes the name of the office of temporary and disability assistance to the office of economic security
sponsored.sum: Changes the name of the office of temporary and disability assistance to the office of economic security.
sponsored.fis: This bill would have a negligible fiscal impact associated with staff time and the cost of materials to change the agency's name. The agency would deplete existing inventories of forms and documents before utiliz- ing documents that reflect the new name. The agency would absorb any costs associated with the name change within existing resources.

sponsored.t: Prohibits hospitals and health care providers from storing credit card information without consent
sponsored.sum: Prohibits hospitals and health care providers from storing credit card information without signed written consent and requires disclosure if such information could be used to pay balances.

sponsored.t: Ensures ovarian cancer survivors have the right to access screenings for health conditions
sponsored.sum: Ensures ovarian cancer survivors have the right to access screenings for health conditions.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet regarding the laparoscopic power morcellation surgery technique
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet regarding the laparoscopic power morcellation surgery technique.

sponsored.t: Creates a temporary state commission concerning the incidence of asthma in Brooklyn
sponsored.sum: Creates a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of asthma in the borough of Brooklyn in New York city.

sponsored.t: Provides for the use of rooms within a public school at a reasonable rate
sponsored.sum: Provides for the use of rooms within a public school at a reasonable rate.

sponsored.t: Relates to the siting or construction of a qualified energy storage system
sponsored.sum: Requires an applicant filing any application for a permit or authorization relating to the siting or construction of a qualified energy storage system that has a storage capacity greater than one megawatt hour, is connected to the local distribution system and primarily operated for commercial or electric retail purposes, and is not constructed in connection with a major renewable energy facility to provide notice of such application to the chief executive of the city, town, or village in which it is located and each member of the state legislature within whose district the proposed energy storage system is to be located.

sponsored.t: Establishes an awareness campaign on the use of hormone replacement therapy in treating the symptoms of perimenopause and menopause
sponsored.sum: Establishes an awareness campaign on the use of hormone replacement therapy in treating the symptoms of perimenopause and menopause.

sponsored.t: Relates to the mandatory coverage of hearing aids by insurers and other organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to the mandatory coverage of hearing aids by insurers and other organizations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the small business crime prevention services
sponsored.sum: Establishes the small business crime prevention services program to provide small businesses with information on strategies, best practices and programs offering training and assistance in prevention of crimes in and around the premises of small businesses or otherwise affecting small businesses, including but not limited to: assault, arson and other violent felony offenses; robbery, burglary, theft, identity theft counterfeiting, check and credit card fraud and other fraud; and vandalism, graffiti and other property damage; provides that information on eligibility and applications for financial assistance be made available to small businesses; authorizes the New York state urban…
sponsored.fis: Any additional resources needed for the Division for Small Business are expected to be offset by the economic benefits of crime prevention, including the prevention of direct economic losses to the State through lower sales tax and income tax collections and the higher costs criminal activities create for law enforcement and courts. The funding of small business crime prevention assistance would be through the Empire State economic development fund (EDF), a multipurpose fund providing grants, loans and other aid to meet various communities' needs. The funding level provided for EDF' purposes varies from year to year and is deter- mined as part of the budget process. Local governments would stand to benefit directly, as recipients of small business crime prevention assistance, as well as through the increased tax revenues resulting from more effective crime prevention.

sponsored.t: Allows certain members of a public body to be counted as present for quorum purposes at meetings attended remotely
sponsored.sum: Allows members of a public body who cannot physically attend a meeting due to a disability to be counted as present for quorum purposes at meetings attended remotely; makes provisions of law relating to permitting videoconferencing and remote participation in public meetings under certain circumstances permanent.

sponsored.t: Requires the fee schedule for appropriate current procedural terminology and proprietary laboratory analysis codes be regularly updated for all mandatory biomarker precision medical testing coverage
sponsored.sum: Requires the fee schedule for appropriate current procedural terminology and proprietary laboratory analysis codes be established and regularly updated for all mandatory biomarker precision medical testing coverage by the department of health.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount certain individuals are eligible for when receiving enhanced residential care
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount certain individuals are eligible for when receiving enhanced residential care.

sponsored.t: Increases the federal poverty level requirement for recipients where it concerns the one-time disregard of earned income
sponsored.sum: Increases the federal poverty level requirement for recipients where it concerns the one-time disregard of earned income following job entry.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination against any individual with an actual or perceived status as a victim of domestic violence, a sex offense, or stalking
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination against any individual with an actual or perceived status as a victim of domestic violence, a sex offense, or stalking; requires training on discrimination against individuals with an actual or perceived status as a victim of domestic violence, a sex offense, or stalking.

sponsored.t: Provides that applicants or recipients for SNAP benefits shall not be subjected to finger imaging as a requirement of the supplemental nutrition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Provides that applicants for or recipients of SNAP benefits shall not be subjected to finger imaging as a requirement of the supplemental nutrition assistance program.

sponsored.t: Requires that two electronic benefit transfer credit or debit cards be available to certain households receiving special supplemental nutrition program for women, infants and children (WIC) benefits
sponsored.sum: Requires that any electronic benefit transfer services for special supplemental nutrition program for women, infants and children (WIC) benefits shall ensure that two electronic benefit transfer credit or debit cards are issued for use by any recipient household where such additional household member is either a parent, guardian or caretaker of the covered infant or a spouse, domestic partner or parent of the covered mother.

sponsored.t: Establishes a maternal health monitoring pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a maternal health monitoring pilot program within the department of health to offer eligible participants improved maternal health care through remote patient monitoring for maternal hypertension and maternal diabetes; requires delivery of a report.
sponsored.fis: Any fiscal implications associated with the pilot program will be evalu- ated through the program's reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Requires telephone corporations provide on their website information and materials pertaining to victims of domestic violence and opting-out of a bundle telephone contract
sponsored.sum: Requires telephone corporations to create a subsection on their websites with information and materials pertaining to victims of domestic violence and opting-out of a bundle telephone contract with such telephone corporation due to a person's status as a victim of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Requires genetic testing results only be received by patients and health care providers providing direct care while health insurance companies only receive a record that the genetic testing was performed
sponsored.sum: Requires genetic testing results only be received by patients and health care providers providing direct care while health insurance companies only receive a record that the genetic testing was performed; provides insurers cannot require access to genetic testing results and cannot take adverse action against someone for not providing genetic testing results.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay; imposes a five-year moratorium on placing sediment or fill in the borrow pits in Jamaica Bay.

sponsored.t: Establishes an annual food tax holiday exempting sales taxes on certain currently taxable food items in November or December
sponsored.sum: Establishes an annual food tax holiday exempting sales taxes on certain currently taxable food items, including hot and cold prepared foods intended for immediate consumption, and any other ready-to-eat item sold in a grocery store, deli or food counter, meals purchased at a restaurant including takeout and delivery orders, in November or December.
sponsored.fis: There will be a temporary reduction in state sales tax revenues during the designated two-week period each year. Participating local govern- ments will be reimbursed by the state for revenue losses attributable to the exemption. A full fiscal analysis will be conducted by the Division of the Budget

sponsored.t: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to make publicly available on its website information regarding waivers, rental supplement plans and shelter supplement plans
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to make publicly available on its website information regarding waivers, rental supplement plans and shelter supplement plans.

sponsored.t: Requires appearance enhancement business and cosmetology licensees and trainees to disclose the price of cosmetology services
sponsored.sum: Requires appearance enhancement business and cosmetology licensees and trainees to disclose the price of cosmetology services both verbally and through signage.

sponsored.t: Establishes protections for the rights of pregnant students, parenting students, and students with pregnancy-related conditions in schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes protections for the rights of pregnant students, parenting students, and students with pregnancy-related conditions in schools; requires schools to establish liaison officers for such students and to disseminate information relating to resources available to such students; directs that rules be established to administer such rights and to establish minimum periods of time for a leave of absence at the student's option.

sponsored.t: Relates to school bus parking on New York City streets
sponsored.sum: Prohibits school bus parking on city streets on weekdays between the hours of 5 p.m. and 5 a.m. and on weekends from 5 p.m. on Friday to 5 a.m. on Monday.

sponsored.t: Provides eligibility for state or local public benefits regardless of immigration status
sponsored.sum: Allows for state agencies, municipalities, and authorities to provide state or local public benefits regardless of immigration status.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowances for the costs of diapers
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing the payment of costs, up to eighty dollars, of diapers for an eligible child two years of age or younger for children receiving safety net assistance.

sponsored.t: Establishes the rare disease advisory council
sponsored.sum: Establishes the rare disease advisory council to identify best practices, raise awareness regarding rare diseases, evaluate barriers to access to care, and to make recommendations to the legislature and the governor.
sponsored.fis: $100,000 of existing appropriations transferred to State Operations.

sponsored.t: Establishes a blood clot and pulmonary embolism policy workgroup
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to establish a blood clot and pulmonary embolism policy workgroup.

sponsored.t: Relates to jury deliberations
sponsored.sum: Allows for written instructions regarding elements to be supplied to a jury.

sponsored.t: Relates to the unearned income of a child
sponsored.sum: Relates to the unearned income of a child when the parent or non-parent caregiver chooses to exclude such child from the public assistance household.

sponsored.t: Requires the inclusion of cultural competency training in the basic training and pre-employment course curricula for police, firefighters, correction officers and first responders
sponsored.sum: Requires the inclusion of cultural competency training in the basic training and pre-employment course curricula for state police officers and municipal police officers and sheriffs, members of fire departments and companies, corrections officers, first responders, emergency medical technicians and advanced emergency medical technicians.

sponsored.t: Establishes the sanitary retail food store grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the sanitary retail food store grant program to provide funding to retail food stores that fail inspections to correct deficiencies if such stores are unable to sustain the costs to immediately correct critical deficiencies, are located in food deserts, and would otherwise be unable to stay in operation due to their inability to meet and maintain sanitary standards.

sponsored.t: Adds certain human services programs to the designated human services programs eligible for a cost of living adjustment
sponsored.sum: Adds certain human services programs to the designated human services programs eligible for a cost of living adjustment.

sponsored.t: Provides targeted inflationary increases for designated programs
sponsored.sum: Provides targeted inflationary increases for designated programs for the 2026-2027 fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Requires social services districts to maintain a waiting list of families who have applied for child care assistance and data regarding the income of such families
sponsored.sum: Requires each social services district to maintain a waiting list of eligible families who have applied for child care assistance; requires the local districts to report such list to the office of children and family services who shall then compile such reports and issue one report to the legislature annually; requires the social services districts to collect data regarding the income of families who have applied, were denied and received child care assistance and issue a report to the office of children and family services who shall then compile such reports and issue one report to the legislature annually.

sponsored.t: Relates to the visitation rights of great-grandparents
sponsored.sum: Provides that a great-grandparent may apply to the supreme court for visitation rights with respect to certain minor great-grandchildren where either or both of the parents of such child is or are deceased.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school air conditioning system grant program; makes an appropriation therefor
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school air conditioning system grant program to provide schools with funding to install air conditioning systems in certain areas; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Authorizes expedited settlement conference processes for establishing child support orders
sponsored.sum: Authorizes expedited settlement conference processes for establishing child support orders where both parties voluntarily agree on the process.
sponsored.fis: To be determined in accordance with federal Title IV-D funds available to the State.

sponsored.t: Relates to resource exemptions for applicants for public assistance programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to resource exemptions for applicants for public assistance programs; amends the Welfare Reform Act in relation to the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to flexible working arrangements for parents and legal guardians when day care centers and schools are closed during a state or local disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Allows parents and legal guardians to work from home; allows flexible working arrangements during a public health emergency or state or local disaster emergency which closes schools or day care centers; defines terms; creates a rebuttable presumption that an employee can work remotely if such employee has done so for two consecutive pay periods or two weeks; creates a civil penalty for violations.

sponsored.t: Creates an educational pamphlet regarding the importance of prostate-specific antigen testing
sponsored.sum: Creates an educational pamphlet regarding the importance of prostate-specific antigen testing.

sponsored.t: Provides test preparation for certain students intending to apply to take the specialized high school admissions test
sponsored.sum: Provides test preparation for students in the seventh grade and eighth grade intending to apply to take the specialized high school admissions test.

sponsored.t: Establishes a mandated window of five business days for both Medicaid and private insurers to respond to pre-authorization claims for testing and/or treatments made by physicians on behalf of oncology patients
sponsored.sum: Establishes a mandated window of five business days for both Medicaid and private insurers to respond to pre-authorization claims for testing and/or treatments made by physicians on behalf of oncology patients.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the standards of monthly need and home energy grant amounts for persons in receipt of public assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the standards of monthly need and home energy grant amounts for persons in receipt of public assistance.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of certain hazardous inhalants to persons under the age of twenty-one
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of certain hazardous inhalants to persons under the age of twenty-one.

sponsored.t: Requires a mortgagor to provide notice of imminent foreclosure
sponsored.sum: Requires a mortgagor to provide notice of imminent foreclosure to their tenant or prospective tenant prior to renewing or signing a lease agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to tax preparation and voter registration software
sponsored.sum: Requires that all electronic tax preparation software offered for sale in the state of New York include a prompt providing a link to users of such software to a New York state voter registration application website.

sponsored.t: Establishes the incontinence supplies insurance program for Medicaid beneficiaries
sponsored.sum: Establishes the incontinence supplies insurance program for Medicaid beneficiaries who are also residents of the state of New York and obtain a note from a physician indicating a need for an item.

sponsored.t: Requires that a state employee, who is transferred from one state agency to another because such employee's previous position was eliminated, be entitled to certain benefits
sponsored.sum: Provides that a state employee whose position is eliminated for certain reasons and who is subsequently transferred to a different agency be entitled to the same hourly salary, retain all accrued sick leave, retain, cash out or use all accrued vacation time, and be paid relocation expenses.

sponsored.t: Enacts into law major components of legislation which are necessary to implement the New York healthy incentive program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York healthy incentive program (Part A); automates SNAP and the New York healthy incentive program (Part B); establishes the New York healthy incentive program outreach program (Part C).

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance policies to offer full coverage for annual testing for ovarian cancer and requires certain health care providers offer annual testing for ovarian cancer
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies to offer full coverage for annual testing for ovarian cancer; requires certain health care providers offer annual testing for ovarian cancer.

sponsored.t: Prohibits virginity examinations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits health care practitioners from performing a virginity examination or supervising the performance of a virginity examination on a patient; defines "virginity examination".

sponsored.t: Requires instruction concerning traffic stops in pre-licensing courses
sponsored.sum: Relates to instruction concerning traffic stops in pre-licensing courses to provide drivers with their responsibilities when stopped by a law enforcement officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing fines for individuals who fail to comply with a stop work order
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing fines for individuals who fail to comply with a stop work order; increases fines from $6,000 to $10,000 for initial violation and $12,000 to $20,000 for subsequent violations.

sponsored.t: Requires clinical trials that apply for state grant funding to make certain information about such clinical trials public
sponsored.sum: Requires any sponsor of a clinical trial in this state, including but not limited to, a pharmaceutical drug manufacturer, pharmaceutical drug wholesaler, academic medical center, voluntary group, federal agency or health care provider, that applies for a state grant to conduct such clinical trial, to conspicuously post certain information about such clinical trial on the department's website.

sponsored.t: Creates esophageal cancer educational pamphlets and requires esophageal cancer testing and treatments be covered by certain insurance plans
sponsored.sum: Creates esophageal cancer educational pamphlets; requires esophageal cancer testing and treatments be covered by certain insurance plans.

sponsored.t: Allows for certain disability benefits to continue in the event an individual who is receiving such benefits gets married
sponsored.sum: Allows for certain disability benefits to continue in the event an individual who is receiving such benefits gets married; provides that the marriage to another individual which would otherwise make an individual ineligible for certain disability benefits shall not be considered if such individual is already receiving disability benefits at the time of becoming married and continues to meet certain criteria.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York state cancer services program to provide various cancer screenings and diagnostic services at no cost; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York state cancer services program to provide various cancer screenings and diagnostic services at no cost to certain persons and to provide informational pamphlets on such cancers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a grant program for the installation of laundry equipment and facilities in certain schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes a grant program for public K-12 schools which are eligible for support provided under Title I of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, for the purposes of installing laundry equipment for facilities for use by students and parents or guardians of students.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the office of children and family services to conduct a study on the family assessment response program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the office of children and family services to conduct a study on the family assessment response program; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the maximum hours for home care aides
sponsored.sum: Places limits on the maximum amount of hours a home care aide may be required to work without voluntarily consenting to such an assignment.

sponsored.t: Establishes an EBT card replacement program
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of temporary and disability assistance to develop and implement a program to replace all EBT cards issued in the state which utilize magnetic strips with cards that utilize chip technology.

sponsored.t: Issues distinctive epilepsy awareness license plates and establishes an epilepsy awareness fund and an epilepsy research and education program
sponsored.sum: Issues distinctive epilepsy awareness license plates; establishes an epilepsy awareness fund and an epilepsy research and education program.

sponsored.t: Requires third-party accommodation reservation services identify themselves as such to users and not charge certain fees
sponsored.sum: Requires third-party accommodation reservation services identify themselves as such to users and not levy certain cancellation fees.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance coverage for mammography by either mammogram and breast ultrasound or breast tomosynthesis for persons with certain breast densities
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance coverage for mammography by either mammogram and breast ultrasound or breast tomosynthesis for persons with heterogeneously dense or extremely dense breasts.

sponsored.t: Creates caseload standards for adult protective services workers
sponsored.sum: Creates caseload standards for adult protective services workers such that such workers have no more than thirty cases at any time.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for diagnosis and treatment of fibroids
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for procedures relating to the diagnosis and treatment of uterine fibroids and related conditions, including pain, discomfort and infertility resulting therefrom.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of social services to issue EMV-compliant or similar electronic benefit transfer cards and process all electronic benefit transfer system transactions using dynamic data authentication
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of social services to issue EMV-compliant or similar electronic benefit transfer cards and process all electronic benefit transfer system transactions using dynamic data authentication.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health care providers to disclose certain facts in regard to probation to current and new patients
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health care providers to disclose certain facts in regards to probation to current and new patients.

sponsored.t: Requires the disclosure of prices and additional charges at appearance enhancement businesses which practice nail specialty
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of prices and additional charges at appearance enhancement businesses which practice nail specialty.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for taxpayer gifts for uterine fibroids education and establishes the uterine fibroids education fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing for taxpayer gifts for uterine fibroids education; establishes the uterine fibroids education fund.

sponsored.t: Permits a real property tax freeze to be granted to certain persons sixty-five years of age or older
sponsored.sum: Permits persons sixty-five years of age or older to be granted a real property tax freeze in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Exempts baby bottles and bottle nipples from sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts baby bottles and bottle nipples from sales and compensating use tax.
sponsored.fis: The exemption of baby bottles and bottle nipples from sales tax will result in a minor reduction in state tax revenue; however, this is expected to be offset by the long-term benefits of supporting families and reducing the economic stress associated with raising children.

sponsored.t: Exempts infant car seats from sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts infant car seats from sales and compensating use tax.
sponsored.fis: The bill is expected to result in a small reduction in state tax reven- ue. However, the overall fiscal impact is anticipated to be minimal and is outweighed by the public safety benefits and financial relief for families.

sponsored.t: Exempts breast pumps and breast pump kits from sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts breast pumps and breast pump kits from sales and compensating use taxes; defines terms.
sponsored.fis: The fiscal impact of this bill is expected to be minimal. The benefits of supporting breastfeeding, including potential healthcare savings from healthier infants and mothers, are anticipated to outweigh the revenue loss from the tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the reissuance of certain benefits in instances of fraud or theft of benefits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the reissuance of emergency assistance to needy families with children, safety net assistance, SNAP benefits, or emergency assistance for aged, blind and disabled persons in instances of fraud or theft of benefits.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to maintain a publicly available database of the results of its graded inspections on its website
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to maintain a publicly available database of the results of its graded inspections on its website; requires the department to provide information as to where a customer may file a consumer report; requires the department to facilitate and coordinate the planning and implementation of an awareness and educational program to inform the general public on the standards retail food stores shall meet and how consumers may report retail food stores with poor sanitary conditions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Olivia Rae Salta, the daughter of Dawn Jimenez-Salta, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Olivia Rae Salta, the daughter of Dawn Jimenez-Salta, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system on behalf of her deceased mother.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of computer tampering in the third degree
sponsored.sum: Adds that a person is guilty of computer tampering in the third degree when they intentionally enter or alter in any manner or destroy computer material indicating that a person did or did not receive a vaccination that is reported to the New York state immunization information system or the New York city immunization registry.

sponsored.t: Relates to the timeframe for guardianship hearings
sponsored.sum: Increases the timeframe for guardianship hearings to thirty-five days.

sponsored.t: Relates to compensation of individuals appointed by the court as court evaluators in guardianship matters
sponsored.sum: Relates to compensation of individuals appointed by the court as court evaluators in guardianship matters.

sponsored.t: Relates to studying the adequacy of applied behavioral analysis provider networks
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to make publicly available on the department of health website a report concerning access to applied behavior analysis for enrolled children diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder.

sponsored.t: Allows certain campaign funds to be used for accessibility services
sponsored.sum: Allows public campaign funds to be used for disability access services including but not limited to captioning, sign language interpretation, assistive listening device, Braille, large print, communication access real-time translation and accessible transportation services and to be used for language interpretation and translation services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits transcripts being made from video conference meetings by artificial intelligence without conspicuous disclosure during such meeting
sponsored.sum: Prohibits transcripts being made from video conference meetings by artificial intelligence without conspicuous disclosure during such meeting that such meeting may be transcribed by artificial intelligence.

sponsored.t: Requires social services districts to maintain a waiting list of families who have applied for child care assistance and data regarding the income of such families
sponsored.sum: Requires each social services district to maintain a waiting list of eligible families who have applied for child care assistance; requires the local districts to report such list to the office of children and family services who shall then compile such reports and issue one report to the legislature annually; requires the social services districts to collect data regarding the income of families who have applied, were denied and received child care assistance and issue a report to the office of children and family services who shall then compile such reports and issue one report to the legislature annually.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 57 Chapter 676 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 1926, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to requiring social services districts to maintain a waiting list of certain families applying for child care assistance" APPROVED This bill would require each local social services district maintain a waitlist of children awaiting child care assistance if the district is unable to open cases due to a lack of sufficient funding. The bill further would require data collection and reporting on the child care assistance program. Child care has been my topmost priority as Governor. Under my leader- ship, New York has invested more than $8 billion in the child care assistance program. I recognize the importance of transparency into this vital program. However, the data collection required by this bill is not supported by existing systems…

sponsored.t: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay; imposes a five-year moratorium on placing sediment or fill in the borrow pits in Jamaica Bay.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 79 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 33, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to establishing the task force to promote the employment of people with disabilities" Assembly Bill Number 468, entitled: "AN ACT directing the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees" Assembly Bill Number 1988-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to establishing a center for technical assistance relating to age-friendly health systems; and in relation to hospital performance data" Assembly Bill Number 2468, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to creating the state office of the utility consumer advocate" Assembly Bill Number 2497, entitled: "AN ACT establishing a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a…

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the city of New York to transfer and convey certain city owned property to the Bedford-Stuyvesant volunteer ambulance corps
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing the city of New York to transfer and convey certain city owned property to the Bedford-Stuyvesant volunteer ambulance corps.
sponsored.fis: None, except for costs borne by the city of New York to effect the conveyance of the land, and any lost income from otherwise leasing the land to BSVAC.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the amount of the childcare center tax abatement for certain properties in a city having a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the amount of the childcare center tax abatement for certain properties in a city having a population of one million or more for abatements taken in a tax year commencing on or after July first, two thousand twenty-five; provides that no such childcare center tax abatement shall be authorized for any tax year commencing on or after July first, two thousand thirty-two; extends the deadline for application for such childcare center tax abatement to March fifteenth, two thousand twenty-seven.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program to provide alternative dispute resolution and navigator services in child support matters
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program to provide alternative dispute resolution and navigator services to litigants in child support matters in the family court under the auspices of the community dispute resolution center program.
sponsored.fis: This bill would require State funding to implement. 8.

sponsored.t: Expands the membership of the interagency task force on trafficking in persons
sponsored.sum: Expands the membership of the interagency task force on trafficking in persons to include the commissioner of the department of transportation, the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles and the executive director of the New York state thruway authority.

sponsored.t: Establishes an awareness campaign on the use of hormone replacement therapy in treating the symptoms of perimenopause and menopause
sponsored.sum: Establishes an awareness campaign on the use of hormone replacement therapy in treating the symptoms of perimenopause and menopause.

sponsored.t: Relates to the time-limit for appeals in all categories of family court cases
sponsored.sum: Relates to the time limit for appeals in all categories of family court cases and the filing of objections to support magistrate determinations in child support, paternity and parentage proceedings in family court.
sponsored.fis: This bill would have no fiscal impact on the State or local governments. 8.

sponsored.t: Extends current exemptions of income and resources for public assistance programs
sponsored.sum: Extends current exemptions of income and resources for public assistance programs under the welfare reform act of 1997.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have no fiscal impact since the bill will merely extend the current statutory policy.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to enforcement and support obligations through the suspension of driving privileges
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to enforcement of support obligations through the suspension of driving privileges.

sponsored.t: Establishes a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a study on fiscal cliffs in the state's public assistance programs and to make recommendations related thereto
sponsored.sum: Establishes a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a study on fiscal cliffs in the state's public assistance programs and to make recommendations related thereto.
sponsored.fis: No fiscal implications for state or local government.

sponsored.t: Requires electric vehicle charging stations to include at least one space to accommodate wheelchair accessible electric vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires electric vehicle charging stations to include at least one space that is large enough to accommodate wheelchair accessible electric vehicles.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have no direct costs to the State and none to local governments. NYPA, which is funded off-budget, would be responsible for the costs of expanding electric vehicle charging stations and electric vehicle-capable parking spaces available for wheelchair-accessible elec- tric vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the termination of certain subsidies provided to adoptive parents for disabled or hard to place children
sponsored.sum: Relates to the termination of subsidies provided to adoptive parents for disabled or hard to place children; replaces references of "assistance" with "subsidy"; changes the effective date to 90 days.
sponsored.fis: A potential cost savings for the State.

sponsored.t: Relates to doula access during emergency situations
sponsored.sum: Provides that maternal health care facilities are not required to grant doula access during emergencies or when such access could compromise the safety of the patient or health care team.

sponsored.t: Adds medical and health insurance information within the definitions of personal identifying information; repealer
sponsored.sum: Adds medical and health insurance information within the definitions of personal identifying information.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to doulas; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to require all maternal healthcare facilities to include and/or post on the maternal healthcare facility's webpage, lobby, and patient waiting areas information stating a birthing parent is allowed to have a doula present in the maternal health care facility for delivery and/or inpatient care post-delivery.
